answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil swarms by requiring slashable bonds routed across a verification bridge. New participants lock verifiable capital assets, such as tokenized timber deeds, into a state-monitored lagoon before peer settlement. This forces adversaries to incur compounding liquidity lockup and opportunity costs for each synthetic identity deployed. However, the system inherently favors well-funded cartels while excluding capital-constrained, benign autonomous agents.
